user.title: Automation Monitor
user.description: Detects failed automation runs and exposes them as a sensor. No configuration needed.

init.title: Automation Monitor options
init.description: How long an entity referenced by an automation or script must stay continuously unavailable before it's flagged, which entities to exclude from this check entirely, which labels exclude the automations/entities/devices carrying them from monitoring entirely, whether to skip currently turned-off automations, and whether to show a persistent notification for each sensor.

data.exclude_off_automations: Skip automations that are turned off
